decisions.boundary_condition: Treat as a soft default; if true afternoon return departures are unavailable, limited, or unattractive, consider options close to afternoon.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer afternoon return-flight departures, with nearby times acceptable when true afternoon options are limited.
decisions.condition: When booking or comparing round-trip flights and selecting the return-leg departure time.
decisions.default_action: Search for return-flight options departing in the afternoon and present those first when available.
decisions.exception_condition: Do not apply as a universal outbound-leg rule; one supporting dialogue separately used a morning outbound while still preferring an afternoon return.
decisions.name: afternoon_return_departure_preference
decisions.preference_value: Prefer the return flight to depart in the afternoon.
decisions.rationale: Multiple supporting utterances indicate a soft preference for afternoon timing on the return leg, sometimes alongside outbound timing. Keep as a return-departure timing default without generalizing it to all outbound flights.
